dental-implants.title: Dental Implants
dental-implants.tagline: Dental Implants in Turkey | The optimal and final solution for missing teeth
dental-implants.intro: Dental implants represent the latest revolution in modern dentistry, offering the most durable medical alternative to replace a lost or worn tooth without damaging adjacent teeth. At Orec Clinic, we combine advanced digital technology with Turkey's most skilled doctors to ensure world-class success rates and a pain-free treatment experience.

sections.heading: Basic Components of a Dental Implant
paragraphs: A dental implant consists of three main parts that fuse together to give the look and feel of a natural tooth:

blocks.title: The Root or Implant (Fixture)
blocks.text: A small screw made of pure titanium, implanted into the jawbone to replace the natural root. Titanium is chosen for its biocompatibility, allowing it to fuse with bone (osseointegration) without rejection, sensitivity, or tumor formation.

blocks.title: The Abutment
blocks.text: The connecting piece that is placed on top of the implant to attach it to the external crown.

blocks.title: The Crown
blocks.text: The visible artificial tooth, made from high-quality, durable materials like Zirconia or E-Max to blend naturally with your other teeth in terms of strength and shine.

sections.heading: Types of Dental Implant Techniques at Our Clinic

blocks.title: Traditional or Standard Implants
blocks.text: Mechanism: The roots are implanted into the jawbone, followed by a waiting period of 3 to 4 months for the bone to fully integrate with the implant. Once stabilized, the final tooth is placed.

blocks.title: Immediate Implants
blocks.text: Mechanism: An advanced technique where the implant is placed directly into the jaw or facial bone (bypassing long waiting periods, usually immediately after extracting the damaged tooth). The procedure is completed in one or two sessions. Suitable for: Ideal for urgent cases requiring travel, patients with excellent bone density, and those with blood thinning or diabetes under careful medical supervision and precise planning.

blocks.title: Fixed Jaw Implant (All-on-4 & All-on-6)
blocks.text: Mechanism: In cases of complete tooth loss and gum atrophy, only 4 or 6 roots are implanted directly into the jawbone. Two of these implants are placed at an angle of up to 65 degrees to maximize bone contact and stability, avoiding sinus cavities. A full denture is then permanently fixed to these roots.

sections.heading: Candidates for Dental Implants
list: Individuals over 17-18 years old, as the jawbone continues to grow below this age.
Cases of tooth loss due to accidents, diseases, or contact sports.
Those experiencing difficulties chewing food or pronouncing words due to missing teeth.

blocks.title: Pre-Implant Procedures (Digital Planning)
blocks.text: Patients should inform their doctor of any chronic conditions such as bleeding disorders, diabetes, or high blood pressure (especially diabetic patients must have stable long-term HbA1c levels). The dentist performs a 3D CT scan of the teeth to determine bone thickness, density, nerve endings, and sinus locations for precise implant placement.

blocks.title: Procedure Details
blocks.text: The procedure is performed under local anesthesia (or conscious sedation as per patient preference) without pain. Implants (single tooth, multiple teeth, or full jaw) are placed according to the pre-planned digital strategy.

sections.heading: Risks of Dental Implants and How We Avoid Them
paragraphs: Like any surgical procedure, implants may carry potential risks such as nerve damage, gum recession around the implant, severe bleeding, rejection through swelling, tissue damage, or wound healing failure.

blocks.title: 💡 The Secret to Success
blocks.text: Most of these risks are completely avoided based on the dentist's experience and precise digital planning. At Orec Clinic, we offer you Turkey's most skilled doctors to ensure dental implants that prevent implant failure or associated risks.

hollywood-smile.title: Hollywood Smile
hollywood-smile.tagline: Hollywood Smile in Turkey | The secret to attractiveness, confidence, and lasting radiance
hollywood-smile.intro: A beautiful smile means confidence in yourself, and a Hollywood Smile in Turkey is now within your reach. At Orec Clinic, we offer the finest types of porcelain veneers for harmonious teeth and brilliant white radiance. A Hollywood Smile provides a healthy appearance with evenly aligned teeth that lasts for a very long time without changing color or staining.

sections.heading: How to Get a Hollywood Smile? (Procedure Steps)
paragraphs: The procedure is carried out through a detailed treatment plan that includes:

blocks.title: Comprehensive Treatment
blocks.text: Treating all previous dental issues (cavities, gum inflammation) before starting any cosmetic steps.

blocks.title: Enamel Preparation
blocks.text: A very minimal microscopic grinding to create space for the porcelain veneers.

blocks.title: Veneer Placement
blocks.text: Precise bonding of the veneers using highly durable medical adhesive materials.

sections.heading: Candidates for a Hollywood Smile
list: Individuals with severe and stubborn tooth discoloration.
Those who frequently consume foods and drinks with high pigmentation, such as coffee, tea, and cigarettes, and want a solution that won't stain in the future.
Gaps between teeth, partially broken teeth, or teeth that are uneven in length and size.

sections.heading: Precautions Before Getting a Hollywood Smile (Medical Disclosure)
paragraphs: It must be confirmed that the case actually requires a Hollywood Smile; if teeth whitening alone would suffice, it's advisable not to proceed, as enamel is ground to allow placement and this is a permanent, irreversible procedure.

If it's confirmed that the case is suitable for a Hollywood Smile in Turkey, treating teeth after placement is very difficult due to the high cost of removal and replacement. Therefore, our doctors ensure all teeth are in excellent condition before placement through:
list: Treating all previous dental issues and ensuring oral health.
Extracting severely compromised teeth and replacing them with cosmetic implants.
Treating or removing the nerve of one or more teeth if necessary to prevent future pain under the veneers.

sections.heading: Treatment Duration and Materials Used
paragraphs: Porcelain veneers or Veneers made from enhanced German Zirconia or pure E-Max are used, typically placed on only the upper arch, only the lower arch, or both arches for a perfect appearance and beautiful smile. The design and laboratory fabrication process takes two to three weeks (including 2-3 clinic sessions).

sections.heading: Aftercare Tips for Hollywood Smile
list: Maintain daily teeth cleaning with a toothbrush, toothpaste, and dental floss to prevent tartar buildup at the gum line.
Avoid biting on very hard objects (like opening bottles with your teeth or pen caps) to protect the veneers from chipping.
Visit your dentist regularly (every 6 months) for check-ups and professional cleanings.

restorative-dentistry.title: Restorative Dentistry
restorative-dentistry.tagline: Restorative Dentistry in Turkey | The health of your teeth is the foundation of your smile's beauty
restorative-dentistry.intro: Before considering any cosmetic procedure, your teeth must be healthy and strong. The Restorative Dentistry department at Orec Clinic is your destination to eliminate pain, cavities, and functional problems using the latest non-invasive techniques with the highest standards of comfort and safety.

blocks.title: Composite Fillings
blocks.text: We completely remove decay and replace it with aesthetic light-cured fillings made of high-quality composite, which perfectly blend with the natural tooth's color and appearance, restoring the tooth's strength and original shape without any distortion.

blocks.title: Root Canal Treatment
blocks.text: We use the latest precise digital equipment to clean deep inflamed and infected nerve canals, completely eliminating pain. This procedure is often completed in a single, quick, and comfortable session under effective local anesthesia.

blocks.title: Dental Crowns and Bridges
blocks.text: To protect weak, broken, or root canal-treated teeth. We use advanced Zirconia and Porcelain crowns that provide strength comparable to natural enamel and can withstand high chewing forces.

blocks.title: Gum Disease Treatment and Gum Contouring
blocks.text: Healthy gums are the frame of a beautiful smile. We offer services such as deep tartar cleaning, gum pocket treatment, and laser gum contouring to eliminate discoloration, inflammation, and bad breath.

sections.heading: Cases That Require Restorative Dentistry
list: Feeling sharp pain or throbbing in teeth when consuming cold or hot foods and drinks.
Presence of gaps, cavities, or fractures in the tooth structure due to decay or excessive pressure.
Bleeding gums while brushing or unpleasant odor from the mouth.

teeth-whitening.title: Teeth Whitening
teeth-whitening.tagline: Teeth Whitening in Turkey | A quick, safe, and non-surgical solution for a vibrant smile
teeth-whitening.intro: If you wish to restore your teeth's natural whiteness and eliminate yellowing caused by daily lifestyle without grinding teeth or placing veneers, the Teeth Whitening department at Orec Clinic offers you the most effective and safest medical solutions on the enamel layer.

sections.heading: Our Advanced Teeth Whitening Systems
paragraphs: We offer two main complementary options for the best and most durable results:

blocks.title: In-Office Laser Whitening (In-Office Laser / Zoom Whitening)
blocks.text: Mechanism: A single quick session taking less than one hour. The dentist applies a professionally concentrated whitening gel to the teeth, then activates it using advanced laser or (Zoom) light. Result: Immediate teeth lightening by 6 to 8 shades in the same session, with complete gum protection using a special barrier.

blocks.title: Custom Home Whitening Trays (Home Whitening Kits)
blocks.text: Mechanism: The dentist takes an impression of your teeth and creates flexible plastic trays that perfectly match your mouth dimensions, which are given to you with a safe at-home whitening gel. Result: Use them at home for several days to maintain your in-office whitening results for as long as possible, or for gradual and comfortable lightening.

sections.heading: Candidates for Teeth Whitening
list: Yellowing caused by smoking, frequent consumption of tea, coffee, and carbonated drinks.
Natural tooth whitening decline due to aging.
Patients with well-aligned and uniform teeth who only need brightness and color lightening.

sections.heading: Important Tips to Maintain Your Teeth's Whiteness After Treatment
list: Completely avoid colored foods and drinks (coffee, tea, curry, tomatoes) and smoking for 48 hours after treatment (the white diet period), as teeth are more susceptible to absorbing pigments during this time.
Rinse your mouth immediately with water after consuming any dark-colored drink in the future.
Use whitening toothpaste once or twice a week for routine maintenance according to your doctor's instructions at Orec Clinic.
